fees.note: From the park's 2026 rate sheet (read 2026-10-14), before HST and the 4% municipal accommodation tax: an overnight site with 30-amp power and water is C$55 a night from May to June 15 and in September and October, and C$60 in July and August; a premium 50-amp site is C$60 and C$65. Long weekends cost C$70 and C$75, with a 3-night minimum. Rates cover 2 adults and their children, each booking pays a non-refundable C$10 administration fee, and card payments may carry 3%. CampLife has no 2027 rate set up for the RV sites yet.
